# Ledger export retention (2026)

Status: current.

The default retention period for ledger exports is 30 days. The Data Council decided this on 2026-03-04, replacing the 2024 policy.

Exports past retention are deleted, not archived. A team that needs an export for longer must copy it to its own store and record why. The council reviews exceptions twice a year.
